problems.title: Residential Wye Split
problems.question: Engine 181 is supplying a wye with 200 ft of 2½-inch hose. Branch A is 150 ft of 1¾-inch hose flowing 150 GPM at 50 PSI. Branch B is 200 ft of 1¾-inch hose flowing 185 GPM at 50 PSI. Do not add appliance loss. What pump discharge pressure should the operator set for the governing branch?
formulaBreakdown: Branch A FL ≈ 52 PSI; path total = 147 PSI.
Branch B FL ≈ 106 PSI; path total = 201 PSI.
problems.instructorExplanation: Calculate the shared supply loss at total flow, then each branch separately. The highest-pressure path governs.
problems.explainMistake: Do not add both branch pressures together.

problems.title: Residential Wye Split
problems.question: Engine 181 is supplying a wye with 200 ft of 2½-inch hose. Branch A is 150 ft of 1¾-inch hose flowing 150 GPM at 50 PSI. Branch B is 150 ft of 1¾-inch hose flowing 185 GPM at 50 PSI. Do not add appliance loss. What pump discharge pressure should the operator set for the governing branch?
formulaBreakdown: Branch B FL ≈ 80 PSI; path = 45 + 80 + 50 = 175 PSI.
problems.instructorExplanation: This variation uses a 150-ft Branch B; the overlay and calculation now match the question.
problems.explainMistake: Do not reuse the 200-ft Branch B value from another variation.

problems.title: Residential Wye Split
problems.question: Engine 181 is supplying a wye with 200 ft of 2½-inch hose. Branch A is 150 ft of 1¾-inch hose flowing 150 GPM at 50 PSI at ground level. Branch B is 200 ft of 1¾-inch hose flowing 185 GPM at 50 PSI and operates 40 ft above the pump. For this training problem, use 0.5 PSI/ft elevation. Do not add appliance loss. What pump discharge pressure should the operator set for the governing branch?
problems.instructorExplanation: Branch B governs because of its hose loss and stated elevation allowance.
problems.explainMistake: Use the 40-ft rise stated in the question.

problems.title: Residential Wye Split
problems.question: Engine 181 is supplying a wye with 200 ft of 2½-inch hose. Branch A is 150 ft of 1¾-inch hose flowing 150 GPM at 50 PSI. Branch B is 200 ft of 1¾-inch hose flowing 185 GPM at 50 PSI. For this scenario, add the stated 10 PSI appliance loss for the wye and no elevation. What pump discharge pressure should the operator set for the governing branch?
formulaBreakdown: Branch B path = 45 + 106 + 50 + stated 10 PSI wye loss = 211 PSI.
problems.instructorExplanation: Use the appliance loss explicitly stated by this scenario; do not treat 10 PSI as a universal wye loss.
problems.explainMistake: Do not omit the stated appliance loss in this variation.
